limitations: The full set consists of 32 manually constructed development fixtures; it is neither representative nor blind.
The token admission cap causes native_adapter to fall back to the ordinary chat transport, unlike the unlimited native default.
A token admission limit and an accounting stop are not provider monetary guarantees.
Model outcomes are stochastic; one paired run cannot establish semantic non-inferiority.
The extension was chosen after inspecting the 12-case pilot; it includes all remaining fixtures in dataset order.
Cases without a completed model response are unscorable, not successful abstentions.
Failed requests may have unreported provider usage; their reservation is not an actual charge.
The weighted index is not a provider invoice.
Line and exact-witness matches are proxies; semantic accuracy remains unmeasured.
